answer: When k identities equivocate in a correlated way, bonded escrows incur a penalty proportional to k², reflecting pairwise coordination rather than treating each claim independently. Detection also applies a protocol-defined exponential capital-loss multiplier across linked bonds, making a sybil swarm risk substantially more than its linear stake; asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery from erasing that cost. Like willow and cedar amid a tide, identity labels do not shield shared control.
